hazard: ADS vehicle struck while stationary (stopped or parked)
risk_treatment: Stop placement and hazard lights; avoid stopping in travel lanes; MRC location choice

hazard: Collision while the ADS vehicle is moving
risk_treatment: Collision avoidance testing on every release; scenario library growth from field events
monitoring_metric: Moving-collision rate; CUSUM on any-injury crashes

hazard: Conflict with cyclist pedestrian or scooter rider
risk_treatment: VRU-focused scenario coverage; conservative speed near VRUs

hazard: Conflict with heavy truck or bus
Sensor or compute degradation leading to an in-lane stop
risk_treatment: Redundant sensing and compute; fallback trajectory; pull-over preference
Staffing model for demand surges; guidance confirmation; HRA of the task
monitoring_metric: Assist response time; guidance error rate

hazard: Behavior regression introduced by a software release
risk_treatment: Release gating on scenario library; staged rollout; sequential field monitoring
monitoring_metric: CUSUM on crash and leading-indicator rates
